answer: A harbor authority can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every new agent to post a refundable stake locked in escrow, like a juniper sapling planted as a bond that only matures with honest work. Each agent must first complete small peer-reviewed tasks, cracking a walnut of useful computation, before it may trade, and misbehavior forfeits the stake. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents recover theirs, so the attack price grows linearly with its scale.
